updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: New versions of the app come from GitHub. Your files, key and settings stay on this computer.
updates.loadFailed: Could not load the update information
updates.restarting: The app is restarting. This page will come back by itself in a minute or two.
updates.dev: Developer mode: the app was started from source code, so installing updates and stopping the app from here are turned off.

unreachable.title: Updates are not available right now
unreachable.text: The update helper does not answer. Everything else in the app works. If this lasts, stop the app and start it again.

current.checkFailed: Could not check for new versions: {message}

versions.title: Available versions
versions.hint: You can install any of them, not only the newest.
versions.needsFrom: This version can be installed only from version {version} or newer, and you have {current}. Install an earlier version from the list first.
versions.notInstallable: This version cannot be installed directly. Install an earlier version from the list first.
versions.failedBefore: Installing this version failed before. You can try again.

install.confirmText: First a copy of the database is made, then the app downloads the new version and restarts. It takes a few minutes; the page will be unavailable for a short while.
install.confirmBusy: {n} job is running. The update waits until it finishes. | {n} jobs are running. The update waits until they finish.

force.requested: Updating without waiting for running jobs.
force.confirmText: Running jobs will be interrupted, and you may need to start them again.

progress.rolledBack: Update to {version} failed, version {from} was put back
progress.restartNote: The app will restart during the update. You can leave this page open.
progress.waiting: Waiting for {n} running job to finish: | Waiting for {n} running jobs to finish:

state.verifying: Checking that the new version works

settings.title: Settings
settings.devNote: In developer mode these settings have no effect.
settings.timeHint: Updates start at this time if the computer is on. If jobs are running, the update waits for them.
settings.tzMismatch: The update time is set in {saved}, but this computer uses {local}.
settings.betaHint: Test versions come earlier but may have bugs. With automatic updates on, they are installed too.

stop.title: Stop the app
stop.text: Turns off all parts of the app on this computer. To start it again, open start.command (Mac) or start.bat (Windows) in the app folder.
stop.confirmText: Running jobs will be interrupted and this page will stop working. To start the app again, open start.command (Mac) or start.bat (Windows) in the app folder.
stop.started: The app is stopping. To start it again, open start.command (Mac) or start.bat (Windows).

notice.later: Remind me about the next version
notice.updated: The app was updated to version {version}. Reload the page to use it.

errors.updates_dev_mode: Developer mode: installing updates and stopping the app from here are turned off.
errors.update_busy: An update is already running. Try again when it ends.
errors.update_not_newer: This version is not newer than the installed one.
errors.update_needs_beta: This is a test version. Switch the channel to Beta first.
errors.update_check_failed: Could not check for new versions: {message}
errors.update_not_found: This version was not found on GitHub. Check for updates and try again.
errors.update_bad_request: The update helper did not accept the request: {message}
errors.updater_unavailable: The update helper does not answer. Everything else in the app works.
errors.forbidden: The request came from another site and was blocked.
